name: Orange Charlotte
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.originalText: One and a half cupfuls of boiling water

ingredients.name: orange juice and pulp

instructions.text: Soak half a box of gelatine in half a cupful of water for two hours
Add one and a half cupfuls of boiling water and strain
Add two cupfuls of sugar, one cupful of orange juice and pulp and the juice of one lemon
Stir until the mixture begins to cool, or about five minutes
Add the whites of six eggs, beaten to a stiff froth
Beat the whole until so stiff that it will only just pour into molds lined with sections of orange

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Soak half a box of gelatine in half a cupful of water for two hours
2. Add one and a half cupfuls of boiling water and strain
3. Add two cupfuls of sugar, one cupful of orange juice and pulp and the juice of one lemon
4. Stir until the mixture begins to cool, or about five minutes
5. Add the whites of six eggs, beaten to a stiff froth
6. Beat the whole until so stiff that it will only just pour into molds lined with sections of orange
7. Set away to cool
